title: VASP structure relaxation (teaching example)
description:
This workflow declaration belongs to the httk workflows-examples teaching repository: it relaxes the geometry of a crystal structure with VASP.
Input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure to relax.
Output role relaxed_structure is a structures entry containing the relaxed geometry, and output role total_energy is a records entry containing the final total energy of the relaxed structure.

outputs.name: total_energy
outputs.description: The final total energy of the relaxed structure.
